label: rs-m10-30y-n3
_why: THE ENGINE LADDER WITHOUT THE INPUT LIFT, PROBED (user, 2026-10-13: "remove in1 for engines specifically, all rungs ... Go with 3 30-year probes"; BALANCE_FRAMEWORK 10.101, FINDINGS F232). Book config/mod_config.jex-dam4s-rs-m10.json = the canon jex-dam4s-rs regenerated through its own recorded chain with --in0-for motor:1. Field diff against the canon: the three motor rungs' inputs divided by 1.2 (steel 36 -> 30, 40.7 -> 33.9, 53.8 -> 44.8; electricity 30.5 -> 25.4; oil 53.8 -> 44.8) and their restated target_be / wage_pct; nothing else. Motivation: engines are about half of the canon's problem market-years (Japan 49, Netherlands 18, Russia 18, France 10 a run); the equilibrium model of F232 puts vanilla's 30 steel per 40 engines at 64% of engine problem-years cleared (today 38%).

_arms.m10: {kind: config, config: config/mod_config.jex-dam4s-rs-m10.json} (+ its tree twin, the canon's byte for byte).

_comparison: the canon's own first 30 years (20261012_203800_jex-dam4s-rs-stitched-n3, F227: same book bar the motor ladder, same telemetry) on engine red flags, the engine order books, motor levels and staffing, world and shortlist GDP; health_vs_ref.mjs at 1866 for dead industries and token markets.

_predictions.engines: engine HIGH problem market-years 1836-1866 well under the canon's (the model says roughly a third to a half fewer over the century; the early years are the import-dependent markets, where the gain comes through cheaper exporters); engine prices in the exporters (Belgium, Britain, USA) lower than the canon's at 1850 and 1860; more motor levels built and staffed than the canon's in 1850-1866
_predictions.steel: steel demand per engine down a sixth; steel prices no higher than the canon's
_predictions.GDP: world GDP to 1866 inside the canon's three-seed range; a small rise at most
_predictions.holds: the probe HOLDS if no run stalls or runs away (world GDP inside the canon's range, nothing dead at 1866) and the engine flags fall; then the next step is the century n=3 with the research bar lengthened 3 -> 4 years per stage (user, same message)

_stop_rule: none: a fixed n=3 of 30-year probes; the stop watcher is NOT armed.
